meta.title: Dual-Agent Guidance
meta.description: One master switch. When on, the main agent only judges and delegates — coding, debugging and information gathering always go to subagents. The subagent model chain (ordered candidates, per-candidate limits, automatic fallback) is chosen in the second-level menu, and every source a subagent reports is checked by deterministic code before it reaches the main context. The Executor runs as a background subagent with its own session; the Critic evaluates its report from the main context's viewpoint and only on an agent-initiated stop. Manual stop returns to armed, waiting for your follow-up, without criticism.
